synopsis: The booklet cites the 2024 ASPRS Positional Accuracy Standards as a reference for laser-scanning accuracy [f13137]. Chapter 5 identifies them as Edition 2, Version 2 and states that their scope covers photogrammetry, lidar, UAS and field survey [f3719]. Together with USGS Lidar Base Specification 2025 rev. A, ASPRS 2024 provides a basis for specifying survey lidar, checking it against control points and reporting geometric accuracy, rather than merely calling it “high accuracy” [f3805, f3859]. The supplied facts identify the applicable standards and verification approach but provide no numerical accuracy thresholds or survey results [f3719, f13137, f3805, f3859].

relations.note: Identifies the exact edition and broader scope of the glossary’s 2024 accuracy reference.
Explains practical specification and control-point checking under the cited accuracy standards.
Clarifies the standards’ role in reporting lidar survey geometric accuracy.
Defined geometric-accuracy reporting supports standards-based specification and checking rather than vague accuracy labels.
